description: What to do, step by step, if the police are arresting you right now.

steps.text: Stay calm. Do not resist, run, or fight - even if the arrest feels unfair.
Ask clearly: 'Am I under arrest, or am I free to go?'
Ask why you are being arrested. You must be told the grounds in writing within 24 hours (s.35(3)).
Say: 'I wish to remain silent until I speak to my lawyer.' You have this right (s.35(2)).
Do not sign any statement until your lawyer is present.
Call your lawyer or a trusted person now.
Note the officers' names, numbers, and the station you are taken to.
